paper.title: Harnessing through-space orbital interactions for multicentred organosulfur catalysis
paper.titleZh: 利用穿空间轨道相互作用实现多中心有机硫催化

coreQuestion: 能否不依赖单个主族中心的几何畸变，而通过多个二价硫原子的空间排列与轨道相位，获得同时利于卤鎓捕获与转移的新型催化电子结构？

editorialStatus.reasonNoWechatWrite: Tomorrow's daily-feature article is not yet fixed; preserve one terminal draft/update for the final two-card bundle.

scienceGuardrails: OS6 is the key experimental four-sulfur control separating sulfur count from orbital phase.
OS7 is in silico only; use computation-level wording.
OS1+Br HRMS uses low-temperature AgSbF6/pyridinium perbromide conditions, not the standard NBS catalytic mixture.
VTNA/initial-rate data support the authors' pre-equilibrium/transfer-limiting model but do not uniquely prove the microscopic resting state.
n(S)->sigma*(S-Br) / three-centre-four-electron assignment is principally computational (DFT/ETS-NOCV).
Weakly coordinating anion dependence is experimentally supported; tight-ion-pair stabilization remains the authors' mechanistic model.
Fig.4 is a deliberately selected difficult-substrate benchmark with mixed reported/in-house values; not a universal ranking.
Fig.5 contains genuine limitations, condition changes and moderate/low-yield cases; do not summarize as one-condition universal scope.
